declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.TopBound.Internal.tail_top_bound'
declarations.type:
∀ {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases},
  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBox K →
    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBases K B →
      ∀ {F sr sz : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ},
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable F (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K.rect) →
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable sr (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K.rect) →
            MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun p => K.lineWeight p.1 * ‖sr p‖ ^ 2) K.rect MeasureTheory.volume →
              MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable sz (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K.rect) →
                MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun p => K.lineWeight p.1 * ‖sz p‖ ^ 2) K.rect MeasureTheory.volume →
                  (∀ (j l : ℕ),
                      j ≠ 0 →
                        ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K j) * B.coef K F j l =
                          ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,
                            ↑(K.lineWeight p.1) * sr p *
                              ↑((1 - K.refR p.1 ^ 2) *
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.SharpCoefTailInternal.rd B j p.1 *
                                  B.heightPoly l p.2)) →
                    (∀ (j l : ℕ),
                        l ≠ 0 →
                          ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K l) * B.coef K F j l =
                            ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,
                              ↑(K.lineWeight p.1) * sz p *
                                ↑(B.radialPoly j p.1 *
                                    ((1 - K.refZ p.2 ^ 2) *
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.SharpCoefTailInternal.hd B l p.2))) →
                      ∀ {Q : ℕ},
                        2 ≤ Q →
                          K.tailNormSq (Q - 1) F ≤
                            (((Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K Q)⁻¹ *
                                  ∑ j, ∑ l, if Q ≤ ↑j + 1 then ‖B.coef K sr ↑j ↑l‖ ^ 2 else 0) +
                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K Q)⁻¹ *
                                  ∑ j, ∑ l, if ↑j + 1 ≤ Q ∧ Q ≤ ↑l + 1 then ‖B.coef K sz ↑j ↑l‖ ^ 2 else 0) +
                              (K.tailNormSq Q sr + K.tailNormSq Q sz) /
                                min (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K Q)
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K Q)

∀ {k : ℕ} {Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry} {P : ℝ} {v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
  {G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {g : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space},
  Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
    0 < P →
      ∀ {m : ℕ},
        Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsModeClass Γ m →
          ∀ {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
            {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} {B : ℝ},
            Breakdown.CoerciveWeak.IsWeakSecondDerivState W HW B →
              ∀ {S : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)},
                Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsHarmonicExpansion S W HW →
                  ∀ (L : Finset (ℤ × ℤ)),
                    (∀ (α : ℤ × ℤ), α ∈ L ↔ Breakdown.CertCell.labelHarmonic m α ∈ S) →
                      ∀ {b : Fin k → ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space},
                        (∀ (i : Fin k),
                            MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => b i z.1 z.2) MeasureTheory.volume) →
                          (∀ (i : Fin k), ∃ C, ∀ (σ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space), ‖b i σ y‖ ≤ C) →
                            ∀ (κ : Fin k → ℝ) {F Pg : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space},
                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsPeriodicPressure Pg →
                                Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsStrongRightSide W b κ v G H g F Pg →
                                  ∀ (ι : ℤ × ℤ),
                                    ∀ᵐ (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                      0 < p.1 →
                                        ∀ (a : Fin 3),
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel m ι F p a =
                                            (↑(Breakdown.CertCell.labelTimeFreq P ι) * Complex.I + 1 / 2) *
                                                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.velAt m ι v a p +
                                                      1 / 2 *
                                                        (↑p.1 * Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt m ι G a 0 p +
                                                          ↑p.2 * Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt m ι G a 2 p) -
                                                    ∑ c, Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.slopeAt m ι H a c c p +
                                                  ∑ α ∈ L,
                                                    ∑ j,
                                                      ∑ l,
                                                        ↑(Breakdown.alternatingSymbol a j l) *
                                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.curlComp
                                                                (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradArray m (ι - α) G
                                                                  p)
                                                                j *
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel m α W p l +
                                                            Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel m α
                                                                (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.vorticityOf W) p j *
                                                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.velAt m (ι - α) v l p) +
                                                ∑ i, ↑(κ i) * Breakdown.CertCell.labelVel m ι (b i) p a +
                                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.velAt m ι Pg a p

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsPatchEntry.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {R : Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.PatchEntry},
  0 < R.inner →
    R.inner < R.outer →
      0 < R.height →
        Measurable R.charge →
          0 < R.chargeLower →
            (∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), R.chargeLower ≤ R.charge p ∧ R.charge p ≤ R.chargeUpper) →
              (∀ (i : Fin R.testCount), LipschitzWith R.testSlope (R.test i)) →
                (∀ (i : Fin R.testCount) (z : ℝ), R.test i (R.inner, z) = 0 ∧ R.test i (R.outer, z) = 0) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin R.testCount) (r : ℝ), R.test i (r, R.height) = 0) →
                    (∀ (s : Fin R.segmentCount), Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsPlaneSegment (R.segment s)) →
                      (∀ (r : ℝ), R.inner ≤ r → r ≤ R.outer → ∃ s, (R.segment s).lower ≤ r ∧ r ≤ (R.segment s).upper) →
                        (∀ (s s' : Fin R.segmentCount),
                            s ≠ s' →
                              (R.segment s).upper ≤ (R.segment s').lower ∨ (R.segment s').upper ≤ (R.segment s).lower) →
                          (∀ (s : Fin R.segmentCount), R.inner ≤ (R.segment s).lower ∧ (R.segment s).upper ≤ R.outer) →
                            (∀ (i : Fin R.testCount) (s : Fin R.segmentCount) (r : ℝ),
                                (R.segment s).lower ≤ r →
                                  r ≤ (R.segment s).upper →
                                    r * R.test i (r, 0) =
                                      ∑ d,
                                        if (R.dataOf d).fst = s then
                                          R.traceMap i d * (R.segment (R.dataOf d).fst).test (R.dataOf d).snd r
                                        else 0) →
                              R.testForm.PosDef →
                                (∀ (c : Fin R.testCount → ℂ),
                                    ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.patch R.inner R.outer R.height,
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.patchGradSq R.label.2 (R.testCombination c) p /
                                            R.charge p *
                                          p.1 ≤
                                      Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.realQuadForm R.testForm c) →
                                  0 ≤ R.factorSlack →
                                    ((1 + R.factorSlack) • 1 - R.factor * R.testForm * R.factor.transpose).PosSemidef →
                                      (∀ (g : Fin R.dataCount → ℂ),
                                          Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm R.credit g ≤
                                            Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.realQuadForm
                                                ((R.factor * R.traceMap).transpose * (R.factor * R.traceMap)) g /
                                              (1 + R.factorSlack)) →
                                        Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsPatchEntry R

              ((coordinates : Breakdown.CertCell.Certificate.IsCoordinateOn D.coords D.pivot) →
                  (factor_nonneg : 0 ≤ D.factor) →

                                            D.pivotValue D.posColumns D.negColumns i j‖ /
                                        D.weight j ≤

  {H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}

  Breakdown.IsPerturbation Γ P v G H g →
    ∀ {m : ℕ},
      Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsModeClass Γ m →
        ∀ {W : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
          {HW : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space} {B : ℝ},

declarations.type:
∀ {m : ℕ} {v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space} {G : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space}
  {H : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space →L[ℝ] Breakdown.Space},

              (∑ a, K.tailNormSq (Q - 1) fun p => Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.velAt m ι v a p) ≤
                (((Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K Q)⁻¹ *
                      ∑ a,
                        ∑ j,

                            if Q ≤ ↑j + 1 then

                    (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K Q)⁻¹ *

                              ‖B.coef K (fun p => Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt m ι G a 2 p) ↑j ↑l‖ ^ 2
                            else 0) +
                  (∑ a, ∑ b, K.tailNormSq Q fun p => Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.gradAt m ι G a b p) /

declarations.name: Breakdown.CertCell.Assembly.Internal.quadForm_inv_le_of_tests
declarations.type:
∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace X] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure X} {n : Type u_2} {κ : Type u_3}
  [inst_1 : Fintype n] [inst_2 : DecidableEq n] [inst_3 : DecidableEq κ] {m : ℕ} (L : n → κ) (T : Finset κ),
  (∀ (i : n), L i ∈ T) →
    ∀ (w : X → ℝ),
      (∀ᵐ (x : X) ∂μ, 0 ≤ w x) →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable w μ →
          ∀ (φ : n → X → Fin m → ℂ) (f : κ → X → Fin m → ℂ),
            (∀ (i : n) (c : Fin m), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => φ i x c) μ) →
              (∀ ℓ ∈ T, ∀ (c : Fin m), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => f ℓ x c) μ) →
                (∀ (i : n) (c : Fin m), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => w x * ‖φ i x c‖ ^ 2) μ) →
                  (∀ ℓ ∈ T, ∀ (c : Fin m), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun x => w x * ‖f ℓ x c‖ ^ 2) μ) →
                    ∀ (G : Matrix n n ℂ),
                      (∀ (i i' : n),
                          G i i' =
                            if L i = L i' then ∫ (x : X), ↑(w x) * ∑ c, φ i' x c * (starRingEnd ℂ) (φ i x c) ∂μ
                            else 0) →
                        G.PosDef →
                          ∀ (t : n → ℂ),
                            (∀ (i : n), t i = ∫ (x : X), ↑(w x) * ∑ c, f (L i) x c * (starRingEnd ℂ) (φ i x c) ∂μ) →
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm G⁻¹ t ≤
                                ∑ ℓ ∈ T, ∫ (x : X), w x * ∑ c, ‖f ℓ x c‖ ^ 2 ∂μ

declarations.type:
∀ {C : Type} {nE nM : ℕ} {m : Breakdown.PieceWeights C nE nM} {h : Breakdown.HarmonicBounds} {w : Breakdown.Space → ℝ},
  (∀ (ξ : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
      m.convD (m.classOf (Breakdown.CertCell.flipLabel ξ)) (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = m.convD (m.classOf ξ) y) →
    (∀ (ξ : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
        m.convZ (m.classOf (Breakdown.CertCell.flipLabel ξ)) (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) =
          m.convZ (m.classOf ξ) y) →
      (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), w (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = w y) →
        (∃ π,
            ∀ (β : Fin nE),
              (m.epsP (π β)).modes = Breakdown.CertCell.flipLabel '' (m.epsP β).modes ∧
                (m.epsP (π β)).frame = -(m.epsP β).frame ∧
                  ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                    (m.epsP (π β)).wt (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = (m.epsP β).wt y ∧
                      (m.epsP (π β)).speed (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = (m.epsP β).speed y ∧
                        (y.ofLp 2 ≠ 0 →
                          (m.epsP (π β)).share1 (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = (m.epsP β).share1 y ∧
                            (m.epsP (π β)).share2 (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = (m.epsP β).share2 y ∧
                              (m.epsP (π β)).len (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = (m.epsP β).len y ∧
                                (m.epsP (π β)).t0 (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = (m.epsP β).t0 y ∧
                                  (m.epsP (π β)).t1 (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = (m.epsP β).t1 y ∧
                                    (m.epsP (π β)).t2 (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = (m.epsP β).t2 y ∧
                                      (m.epsP (π β)).t3 (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = (m.epsP β).t3 y ∧
                                        (m.epsP (π β)).scale (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = (m.epsP β).scale y)) →
          (∃ π,
              ∀ (β : Fin nM),
                (m.muP (π β)).modes = Breakdown.CertCell.flipLabel '' (m.muP β).modes ∧
                  (m.muP (π β)).frame = -(m.muP β).frame ∧
                    (m.muP (π β)).eta = (m.muP β).eta ∧
                      ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                        (m.muP (π β)).wt (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = (m.muP β).wt y ∧
                          (m.muP (π β)).speed (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = (m.muP β).speed y ∧
                            (y.ofLp 2 ≠ 0 →
                              (m.muP (π β)).share (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = (m.muP β).share y ∧
                                (m.muP (π β)).t4 (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = (m.muP β).t4 y)) →
            (∀ β ∈ h.harmonics, Breakdown.CertCell.flipLabel β ∈ h.harmonics) →
              (∀ (β : ℤ × ℤ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                  h.ampW (Breakdown.CertCell.flipLabel β) (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = h.ampW β y ∧
                    h.ampGradW (Breakdown.CertCell.flipLabel β) (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = h.ampGradW β y ∧
                      h.ampVort (Breakdown.CertCell.flipLabel β) (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = h.ampVort β y ∧
                        h.ampGradVort (Breakdown.CertCell.flipLabel β) (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) =
                          h.ampGradVort β y) →
                (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                    h.supVort (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = h.supVort y ∧
                      h.supGradVort (Breakdown.CertCell.flipPoint y) = h.supGradVort y) →
                  (∀ (β : ℤ × ℤ) (φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                      h.ampW β (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) = h.ampW β y ∧
                        h.ampGradW β (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) = h.ampGradW β y ∧
                          h.ampVort β (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) = h.ampVort β y ∧
                            h.ampGradVort β (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) = h.ampGradVort β y) →
                    (∀ (φ : ℝ) (y : Breakdown.Space),
                        h.supVort (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) = h.supVort y ∧
                          h.supGradVort (Breakdown.axialRot φ y) = h.supGradVort y) →
                      (∀ (β : Fin nE), Breakdown.IsAxisymmetric (m.epsP β).speed) →
                        (∀ (β : Fin nM), Breakdown.IsAxisymmetric (m.muP β).speed) →
                          Breakdown.CertCell.Bridge.IsFlipCompatible m h w

declarations.type:

            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeVec L.order 0 (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.harmonicSin ν v) p.1 p.2

declarations.type:

  Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerParts →
    ∀ (D : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerData k C nE nM) (X : Breakdown.CertCell.Instance.InstanceData k C nE nM)
      (R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.CellCalculusEntry D) (T : Breakdown.CertCell.TreeEntry D R) (e : ℝ),

        Breakdown.CertCell.GivenShape.ShapeValuesFacts D →
          ∀ (Y : Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerEntries D R T),
            Breakdown.CertCell.CellLayerEntryConditions D R T e Y →
              (∀ j ∈ D.cert.adjointSet, 0 ≤ D.cert.radius j) →
                (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), D.cert.weightFn y ≤ D.cert.weightMax) →
                  (∑ i, Breakdown.periodLIntegral fun σ y => ‖D.cert.actuator i σ y‖ ^ 2) ≤

declarations.type:
∀ {n : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype n] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (ℝ × ℝ)} (Js : Finset J) (w : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
  (f : ℝ × ℝ → J → ℂ) (φ : n → ℝ × ℝ → J → ℂ),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable w μ →
    (∀ᵐ (p : ℝ × ℝ) ∂μ, 0 ≤ w p) →
      (∀ j ∈ Js, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p => f p j) μ) →
        (∀ j ∈ Js, MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun p => w p * ‖f p j‖ ^ 2) μ) →
          (∀ (i : n), ∀ j ∈ Js, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p => φ i p j) μ) →
            ∀ {C : ℝ},
              0 ≤ C →
                (∀ᵐ (p : ℝ × ℝ) ∂μ, ∀ (i : n), ∀ j ∈ Js, ‖φ i p j‖ ≤ C) →
                  ∀ {c : ℝ},
                    0 < c →
                      ∀ (y : n → ℂ),
                        0 ≤
                            c⁻¹ *
                              Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm
                                (fun i i' => ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ), ↑(w p) * ∑ j ∈ Js, (starRingEnd ℂ) (φ i p j) * φ i' p j ∂μ)
                                y ∧
                          -(2 *
                                  ((star fun i =>
                                        ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ), ↑(w p) * ∑ j ∈ Js, f p j * (starRingEnd ℂ) (φ i p j) ∂μ) ⬝ᵥ
                                      y).re) -
                              c⁻¹ *
                                Breakdown.CertCell.Coupling.quadForm
                                  (fun i i' =>
                                    ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ), ↑(w p) * ∑ j ∈ Js, (starRingEnd ℂ) (φ i p j) * φ i' p j ∂μ)
                                  y ≤
                            c * ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ), w p * ∑ j ∈ Js, ‖f p j‖ ^ 2 ∂μ

declarations.type:
{K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
  {k : ℝ} →
    {R : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.RowProfile} →
      {motive : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsRowProfile K k R → Sort u} →
        (t : Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsRowProfile K k R) →
          ((measurable :
                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable R.vel (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K.rect) ∧
                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable R.grad (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K.rect) ∧
                    MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable R.lap (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K.rect) ∧
                      MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable R.presGrad (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict K.rect)) →
              (integrable :
                  MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn
                    (fun p =>
                      p.1 *
                        (Breakdown.cnormSq (R.vel p) + ∑ a, Breakdown.cnormSq (R.grad p a) +
                            Breakdown.cnormSq (R.lap p) +
                          Breakdown.cnormSq (R.presGrad p)))
                    K.rect MeasureTheory.volume) →
                (laplacian_parts :
                    ∀ (φ : Fin 3 → Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly),
                      Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsAxisRegularTest K k φ →
                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.rowPairing K R.lap φ =
                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.rowBoundaryGrad K R φ -
                            ∫ (p : ℝ × ℝ) in K.rect,
                              ↑p.1 *
                                ∑ a,
                                  ∑ b,
                                    R.grad p a b *
                                      (starRingEnd ℂ) (Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.testGrad K k φ p a b)) →
                  (pressure_parts :
                      ∀ (φ : Fin 3 → Breakdown.CertCell.CellPoly),
                        Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsTestSolenoidal K k φ →
                          Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.IsAxisRegularTest K k φ →
                            Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.rowPairing K R.presGrad φ =
                              Breakdown.CertCell.CellCalculus.rowBoundaryPres K R φ) →
                    motive ⋯) →
            motive t

                        D.cert.weightFn D.azimuthOrder ι p).velocity) →
    ∀ {Γ : Set Breakdown.Symmetry} {P : ℝ} {v : ℝ → Breakdown.Space → Breakdown.Space}
